A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain 17 readable pages, including supplementary Sections A–D and references. Text, equations, tables and figures can be reliably matched despite supplementary renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original stylization experiments, quantitative comparisons and ablations in Section 4, plus supplementary KID results and a 25-participant user study.

after.justification: v3 retains these original quantitative and qualitative experiments, ablations, supplementary KID results and 25-participant user study.

M1.justification: The PanoHead adaptation, LD objective, rank weighting, mirror/grid gradients and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. Replacing 'VQ-VAE' with 'VAE' in descriptive passages does not establish an actual encoder or procedural change.

E1.justification: Both retain synthetic latent training, FFHQ-based evaluation, the same stylization and local-edit prompts, multiview scenarios and user-study coverage. No dataset, task or evaluated domain is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain StyleCLIP, StyleGAN-NADA, StyleGANFusion, DiffusionGAN3D, InstructPix2Pix, InstantID and Instruct-NeRF2NeRF. The LD/PlacidDreamer comparison in Figure 3 and supplementary comparator sets are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Both report 10k training iterations, batch size 1, approximately 100 FFHQ inversions and the same metrics and guidance settings. Supplementary reference-image construction, noise schedules and the randomized 25-participant study protocol remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The LD/PlacidDreamer, latent-space, rank-weighting, ControlNet, grid/SR and mirror-gradient analyses are retained. Mesh comparisons, accessory failure examples and supplementary rank visualizations also contain the same evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain Figure 8's same-seed-across-views statement and the same descriptive user-preference reporting. Neither adds repeated-run counts, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Main Tables 1–2 and the supplementary KID table contain identical values, including the proposed method's Pixar FID of 77.6 and KID of 0.0326. The user-preference plot and qualitative examples also retain the same results; supplementary renumbering introduces no new evidence.

T1.justification: The assumptions, equations and derivations in Section 3 and supplementary Section A are unchanged. Supplementary equations (16)–(23) become (1)–(8), with corresponding cross-reference updates only.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about identity-preserving 360-degree stylization through LD, rank weighting and mirror/grid gradients. No main contribution or claimed empirical advantage changes.

C2.justification: The LD/SDS interpretations and limitations concerning accessories and output resolution remain unchanged. The future-work paragraph is shortened but retains the proposed extension to class-agnostic reconstruction models; it introduces no different applicability boundary or failure condition.

D1.justification: v3 revises the latent-encoder description from 'VQ-VAE' to 'VAE' and acknowledges awarded EuroHPC access to Leonardo at CINECA. These are documentation additions or revisions; the hyperparameters, checkpoint links and single-A100 runtime statement remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 63 references are unchanged. The positioning relative to SDS-based methods and the relationship to PlacidDreamer remain the same.

P1.justification: v3 updates author affiliations, changes 'VQ-VAE' to 'VAE' in three passages, condenses the future-work paragraph and adds acknowledgements. Section order and nearly all prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Supplementary Figures 13–21 become Figures 1–9, and supplementary Table 3 becomes Table 1. Caption wrapping and nearby spacing shift slightly, while the figure contents, table structures and overall layout are retained.

improvement.justification: The encoder terminology update and computing acknowledgement provide small documentation refinements. Main Tables 1–2, supplementary KID and user-study evidence, mathematical derivations and limitations remain unchanged. The shorter future-work text and supplementary renumbering do not materially improve or impair the paper's clarity, reproducibility or scientific support.
